claims.atomic_claim: The Nightfall release tag commit can be resolved.
claims.limitation: Tag commit visibility does not prove binary provenance.

claims.atomic_claim: Candidate GitHub Actions workflow runs can be found for the release tag or tag commit.
claims.limitation: Candidate workflow runs do not prove that release assets came from those runs.

claims.atomic_claim: Workflow artifacts can be found for candidate release workflow runs.
claims.limitation: Artifacts may be expired, incomplete or not identical to release assets.

claims.atomic_claim: Release assets can be linked to workflow artifacts by name.
claims.limitation: Name linkage is heuristic and does not prove source-to-binary correspondence.
Requires stronger provenance and/or reproducible build comparison.
Binary safety cannot be inferred from workflow metadata.
